claims: The Xbox Series X is Microsoft's flagship 1TB console.
The Xbox Series X offers 12 teraflops of power.
The Xbox Series X supports native 4K gaming at up to 120 FPS.
The Xbox Series X features a custom AMD Zen 2 CPU.
The Xbox Series X features an RDNA 2 GPU.
The Xbox Series X features Quick Resume for multiple games.
The Xbox Series X features a 4K Blu-ray drive except in the Robot White All-Digital model.
The Xbox Series X supports four generations of backward compatibility.
The Xbox Series X has 1TB Custom NVME SSD storage.
The Xbox Series X storage is expandable via storage expansion cards.
The Xbox Series X supports true 4K gaming.
The Xbox Series X supports 8K HDR.
The Xbox Series X supports Dolby Vision.
The Xbox Series X supports Dolby Atmos.
The Xbox Series X plays thousands of titles across four generations of Xbox (Original, 360, One, Series X|S).
The Carbon Black (1TB) Xbox Series X model has a standard disc drive.
The Robot White (1TB) Xbox Series X model is All-Digital with no disc drive.
The Galaxy Black (2TB) Xbox Series X model is a special edition with a disc drive.
The Xbox Series X package includes one controller.
The Xbox Series X package includes an Ultra High-Speed HDMI cable.
The Xbox Series X package includes a power cable.
